data.name: Suika 3D
data.detailed_description:
Suika 3D is a physics-based 3D puzzle game about merging fruit inside different containers.

Match two of the same fruit to merge them into a bigger fruit. Keep merging to build your score, unlock larger fruit, and survive for as long as possible before the container overflows.

Unlike a flat 2D merge game, position, depth and momentum all matter. Fruit can roll, bounce, wedge into awkward spaces, knock other fruit loose, or create chain reactions that save — or ruin — your run.

Features

  • 3D fruit-merging gameplay
    Drop fruit into the container, match identical fruit, and create bigger fruit through physics-based merging.

  • Score-focused puzzle runs
    Plan your drops carefully, manage limited space, and chase higher scores with each attempt.

  • Physics-driven chaos
    Every fruit has weight, movement and momentum, making each run slightly different.

  • Multiple levels and containers
    Play across different stylised environments, each with its own environmental effects and feel.

  • Relaxed but tactical gameplay
    The rules are simple, but good placement, timing and recovery from bad bounces make the difference between a short run and a high score.

  • Challenge-based progression
    Complete goals, improve your score, and take on harder challenges as you get better.

  • Low-poly stylised visuals
    Bright, simple fruit and themed environments give the game a clean, playful look.

Suika 3D is designed for quick, replayable puzzle sessions: easy to understand, satisfying to improve at, and chaotic enough that one unexpected bounce can change the whole run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7 SP1+
  • Processor: i3-6098p
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX-760
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: i5-7600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX-1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit only. Keyboard and mouse supported.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5/i7
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated graphics or dedicated Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 or Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
  • Processor: AMD Zen 2 4-core / Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit only
